package: FSP-011 full-proton-response data inventory and assembly
policy: No numerical alpha is fitted. alpha_ref appears ONLY to undo the multiplicative alpha that a cited source applied to its own alpha-free Cottingham integral, and to print comparison values in the source's MeV units. Every quantity labelled per_e2 is the coefficient of u=e^2.

nucleon_kinematics.note: CODATA 2018 masses and magnetic moments in nuclear magnetons, used only as kinematic scale and form-factor normalisation. The measured masses contain their own O(alpha) shifts; at first order in u this changes M_u at relative O(alpha) only.

BBBA05.source: arXiv:hep-ex/0602017v3 (Bradford, Bodek, Budd, Arrington), Table 1 and eq. (6); preferred fit 'Gen > 0, ud = 0.2'
BBBA05.form: G(Q^2) = sum_{k>=0} a_k tau^k / (1 + sum_{k>=1} b_k tau^k), tau = Q^2/(4 M^2)
BBBA05.alpha_status: Elastic Sachs form factors are normalised by G(0) (charge, magnetic moment); cross-section normalisations float in such fits, so the measured alpha cancels at leading order. Radiative corrections enter at relative O(alpha).

dipole_Galster.source: standard dipole G_D=(1+Q^2/Lambda^2)^-2, Lambda^2=0.71 GeV^2 (quoted as such in hep-ex/0602017v3 eq. (2)); Galster G_En=-mu_n tau G_D/(1+5.6 tau)
dipole_Galster.role: second, cruder parametrisation; the spread between the two is a parametrisation-sensitivity indicator, not an uncertainty

CaoDaiGuo_2609.15154v1.quantity: delta m_QED = O(e^2) part of m_p - m_n, eq. (12)-(13), MSbar mu = 2 GeV for the UV counterterm (eq. (15))
CaoDaiGuo_2609.15154v1.inputs: elastic: average over form-factor parametrisations; F1,2: structure functions; Sbar: tripole ansatz normalised by a new dispersive (alpha_E1-beta_M1)^(p-n) built from photoproduction multipoles and gamma gamma -> pi eta / K Kbar amplitudes

GasserLeutwylerRusetsky_2003.13612v3.quantity: m_QED^(p-n), Cottingham with Reggeon-dominance sum rule

alpha_ref.role: inverse of the cited sources' own multiplicative normalisation only (CODATA 2022 value); NOT an input to any QCD quantity computed here

programme_imports.sigma_calibration_from: fine_structure_puzzle/qcd_hard_vacuum/hard_proton/INPUTS.json (sha256 2b0463aa8284529a060aed5e054ca7809a2628daa4d2cff4d366a05f028696c2), key sigma_calibration; FSP-010 combination sigma_u,d=(sigma_piN +/- m_l gS^(u-d))/2
programme_imports.status: FSP-010 source-calibrated leading strong-order local conversion; imported unchanged, not re-derived
